title: Open University Learning Analytics Dataset
design_use: Supports linked learner, assessment and virtual-learning-environment interaction tables
caution: OULAD informs structure only; this project does not claim to reproduce its population or distributions

title: Experience API Data Specification
design_use: Supports event-style learner-resource interaction records with actor, activity and time.
caution: The generated schema is xAPI-inspired and is not an xAPI-conformant statement store

title: IEEE Standard for Learning Object Metadata
design_use: Supports documenting resource title, description, format, difficulty and duration metadata
caution: The catalogue uses a practical subset and does not claim full IEEE LOM compliance

title: Corbett and Anderson Bayesian Knowledge Tracing model
design_use: Supports the idea of unobserved mastery that changes after learning opportunities and produces probabilistic responses.
caution: The generator is only BKT-inspired; it is not a fitted BKT model and does not estimate slip or guess parameters from CAPE data

title: Metadata Embeddings for User and Item Cold-start Recommendations
design_use: Supports combining interaction patterns with learner and resource metadata in a hybrid recommender
caution: This source motivates the downstream model design, not the numerical values used by the simulator

title: Synthetic Data-based Simulators for Recommender Systems
design_use: Supports explicit disclosure of simulator assumptions and evaluation against known simulator truth
caution: Simulated performance does not establish performance with real Caribbean learners.

title: Learning Styles: Concepts and Evidence
design_use: Supports avoiding fixed learning-style labels and modelling format affinity as a noisy behavioural preference instead
caution: Format affinity must not be interpreted as an innate or prescriptive learning style

title: CAPE Computer Science syllabus and subject materials
design_use: Defines the CAPE Unit 1 context and confirms procedural C, arrays, functions, algorithms, tracing and file processing
caution: The public page may block automated access; confirm wording and current syllabus version against the user's authorised syllabus copy.

title: CAPE Computer Science syllabus, specimen papers and subject reports mirror
design_use: Used only to cross-check topic coverage and the procedural-C requirement during catalogue construction.
caution: This is not the preferred citation for the report; replace with the user's official CXC syllabus copy and page references

title: Matrix Factorization Techniques for Recommender Systems
design_use: Supports matrix factorisation as a collaborative-filtering baseline that learns latent learner and resource factors from interaction outcomes
caution: Sparse histories and unseen learners limit this method; cold-start predictions fall back to global and item effects

title: Random Forests
design_use: Supports a nonlinear ensemble model able to represent interactions among learner, content and graph features
caution: Its flexibility does not make its recommendations pedagogically valid; it still learns only the disclosed simulator

title: Ridge Regression: Biased Estimation for Nonorthogonal Problems
design_use: Supports a regularised linear supervised baseline for correlated engineered features
caution: Ridge cannot express complex nonlinear feature interactions without additional transformations

title: Cumulated Gain-Based Evaluation of IR Techniques
design_use: Supports discounted cumulative gain for evaluating the order of graded recommendations
caution: NDCG can appear high when all candidate relevance values are positive and close; top-1 accuracy and random baselines must also be reported
